description: Getting around: one new level-30 Human warrior in Northshire per model, all in one world, with one goal: visit all four Alliance capitals, Stormwind, Ironforge, Darnassus and the Exodar, in any order. They span two continents and an island, so the way is a tram, boats, a portal and some walking, and the order is the agent's to plan. Level 30 so the way is mostly travel, not fighting. Scored on time to the last city; each city is a checkpoint, so a run that doesn't finish shows how far it got.
